channel.title: The Grant Desk - Open Calls, Film & Video, EU, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Open Calls, Film & Video, EU, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
2 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 10 Aug 2026 (10 Aug to 16 Aug 2026).

  • transmediale x Pro Helvetia Digital Art Residency 2027
    transmediale (in cooperation with the Swiss Arts Council Pro Helvetia) · deadline 28 Aug 2026 · Artist fee of CHF 2,000 per month across the two-month residency (CHF 4,000), plus a production grant of CHF 15,000 for the selected project, plus travel and...
  • Pink Screens Queer Film Festival 2026 (Brussels): Submissions Open
    Genres d'a cote · deadline Rolling / undated · Screening at Brussels' queer film festival. Free via the festival's own submission form (FilmFreeway route may charge).

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 13 Jul 2026
item.description:
2 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 13 Jul 2026 (13 Jul to 19 Jul 2026).

  • Mezipatra Queer Film Festival 2026 (27th edition) Submissions
    Mezipatra · deadline Closed 20 Jul 2026 · Competition screening at Central Europe's main queer film festival. A small late-phase submission fee applies (free early bird ended 31 May).
  • RIFF: Reykjavik International Film Festival 2026 Submissions
    Reykjavik International Film Festival (RIFF) · deadline Closed 24 Jul 2026 · Screening at RIFF's 23rd edition. Submission fee 7,600 ISK (approx. EUR 60).
